title: Styling, Themes & Fonts
summary: Use built-in themes, edit ImGuiStyle sizes and colours, write a custom engine theme, apply temporary Push/Pop styles, load TTF fonts for body, headings and code, and scale for DPI.

quiz.q: When must you call io.Fonts->AddFontFromFileTTF() in this engine?
options: Inside Lesson_UI, right before using the font
In Lesson_Init, before the first frame builds the font texture
quiz.explain: The atlas is locked during a frame and baked into a texture by the backend's first NewFrame(). Load every font and size up front.

quiz.q: You call style.ScaleAllSizes(1.5f) every time the user moves the scale slider. What goes wrong?
options: Sizes multiply on top of each other and grow without bound
quiz.explain: ScaleAllSizes multiplies the current values. Rebuild a fresh ImGuiStyle and scale that once.

quiz.q: What happens if you PushStyleColor twice but PopStyleColor() only once?
options: The extra colour leaks into later widgets and ImGui asserts at end of frame
ImGui pops it automatically at End()
quiz.explain: Pushes and pops must balance. PopStyleColor(count) pops several at once.
